title: Spokane Complex Fires
summary: The Old Trails, Fairview and Autumn Lane fires started on August 1, 2026 in Spokane County. Reports put losses at about 850 buildings destroyed and about 67,000 people evacuated.

recorded_alerts.title: Level 3 GO NOW evacuations
recorded_alerts.headline: Spokane County issued Level 3 (GO NOW) evacuation orders for several areas near the Old Trails Fire.
recorded_alerts.description: The fire started near Airway Heights on August 1 and spread toward Spokane's city limits. Leave immediately if you are in a Level 3 area.
recorded_alerts.area: Areas near the Old Trails Fire, Spokane County
recorded_alerts.source_name: CNN (news report of the county's order)

recorded_alerts.title: FEMA fire-fighting funds authorized
recorded_alerts.headline: FEMA authorized a Fire Management Assistance Grant for the Old Trails Fire.
recorded_alerts.description: This pays for fighting the fire. It is not assistance for individuals or families.
